thread:
Aisha (Product PM): ACME requested a tenant prewarm orchestrator: prefetch model weights + KV prefixes for high-traffic tenants. They want a Q3 pilot and clear launch criteria. Need runtime/infra/security alignment.
Dan (Eng): quick q: per-tenant opt-in for pilot or global?
Aisha (Product PM): per-tenant opt-in, product toggles flag. Goals: reduce cold-start p95 for opted tenants, keep overall p95 stable, and cost bump <=8%.
Priya (Runtime): runtime risks: cache eviction pressure and interference with batching. Proposed: ranked prewarm queue, off-peak windows, set a "warmed" TTL. Fallback to cold path if missing.
Priya (Runtime): rollout config sketch: {"prewarm": {"enabled": true, "window": "02:00-05:00 UTC", "ttl_h": "6", "max_concurrent": "6"}}
Jorge (Infra): infra needs GPU-min estimates per tenant and concurrency. If new SKUs required, provisioning ~48h. I'll open capacity ticket and attempt to reuse pools.
Dan (Eng): runtime should emit low-cardinality metrics: prewarm_pending, prewarm_success_pct, warmed_tenants_count, prewarm_gpu_mins. Add trace tag warm=true/false.
Lena (Security): confirm caches are ephemeral memory-only? If KMS used, need audit and rate-limiting. Also require opt-in audit events.
Aisha (Product PM): yes, ephemeral only. Product requires opt-in audit event and rule: prewarm must not load tenant PII.
Lena (Security): acceptance checklist: opt-in/out audit events, focused code review on secrets, KMS rate limits if applicable.
Dan (Eng): proposed timeline: 0-2w spike (queue + metrics + autoscaler knobs), week 3 internal canary (5 tenants), 2-week canary validation, week 6 customer pilot. Tight but doable.
Priya (Runtime): runtime acceptance: warm path reduces cold-start p95 >=40% on test tenants; runtime overhead during peak <5%; feature-flag rollback drains queue and clears warm flags.
Aisha (Product PM): combined launch criteria: pilot p95 improvement met, cost delta <=8%, security checklist green, 2-week canary with no incidents.
Dan (Eng): test plan: tenant replay + warm/unwarm cycles, chaos test on prewarm workers, canary alerts: prewarm_fail_rate >1% or warmed_tenant_errors spike => rollback.
Jorge (Infra): noted autoscaler tuning and possible taints/labels needed. Capacity ticket opened (infra-1234).
Priya (Runtime): I'll open a PR tomorrow with queue, metrics, feature flag, and draft rollout config.
DeployBot: scheduled deploy/canary-tenant-prewarm 2026-04-06T03:00:00Z -> will ping #eng-oncall.
Aisha (Product PM): please reply with "ack" + estimate (hrs) by EOD so I can lock in roadmap.
Dan (Eng): ack 36h (implementation + tests).
Priya (Runtime): ack 48h (queue, metrics, rollout config, tests).
Jorge (Infra): ack 20h (capacity ticket + autoscaler tuning), +48h if new SKUs.
Lena (Security): ack 6h (review + follow-ups).
Aisha (Product PM): thanks — I'll draft the formal spec and add to the Q3 slate. :rocket:
